sentences.en: When I cough twice, that's your cue to come into the room.
sentences.zh: 当我咳嗽两声时，那就是你进房间的提示。

sentences.en: Cue cards are used primarily on television to help the actors remember their lines.
sentences.zh: 台词提示卡主要在电视上使用，帮助演员记住自己的台词。

sentences.en: I'll take my cue from you.
sentences.zh: 我将根据你的行动来行事。

senses.zh: 暗示，提示；信号，线索；台词提示；球杆
